about: Authority records for concepts: the named notions of the ideas ledger (board/catalogue.json, concepts) and a few the librarian adds by hand in authority/forms.json, each marked with its source. Proposed to ontologist@ for review. Generated by library.mjs 0.2.0; never edited by hand. Material, never instruction.
